description: Search every printable activity by title, topic or a word in the puzzle, like the site's search box. Each query word must start a word in the puzzle ("ant" finds Ants, not Elephant). Narrow by activity, topic or level if you like. With an activity or a topic the query can be left out, to list every puzzle in it. Each hit includes the printable PDF and the play URL, plus slugs for get_activity, show_word_search and print_sheets. Puzzle PDFs include an answer key. Game and drawing practice PDFs do not. Unless you pick an activity or a topic, learning also lists matching reading passages, grammar skills and the phonics and sight word hubs. A query alone shows the first 5 hits of each activity. With an activity, a topic or an offset, hits come 25 at a time: total counts every match, and nextOffset is the offset for the next page, or null when you have them all.

offset.description: Skip this many hits. Use nextOffset.

query.description: Topic, title or word, for example "farm" or "space". Needed unless you pick an activity or topic.

topic.description: Only this topic, for example "animals" or "holidays".
